label: The daily model watch: what it may do by itself when a model is gone
description_nl: 2026-09-28 owner: models come and go fast - once a day (rule models_daily) the portal asks every provider for its list. auto_mark_gone: a model offered here that the provider no longer lists is marked gone (cleared by itself when it is listed again). A gone model is swapped for its SUCCESSOR wherever it is used: same_provider = only that provider's models; max_price_ratio = the successor may cost at most this times the old one (1.0 = never more - nobody pays for a model they did not choose). notify_when_nothing: email the owner even when nothing changed.
